newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS WEDNESDAY MIXED ON UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS WEDNESDAY MIXED ON UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar was quoted mixed against hard currencies after a quiet Wednesday interbank session, dealers said.

"Things were pretty static. Nothing happened and the dollar was virtually locked at 10.6400/6600 though there was someone who seemed happy to sell at 10.6550 -- probably he had some money he wanted to get rid of," one dealer commented.
Dealers agreed that the current crisis in the Zimbabwean health system, caused by a three-week-old strike by nurses and doctors, had not had any impact on the foreign exchange market.

On Wednesday the local unit finished the day at 10.6400/6600 against the U.S. dollar, where it has been anchored for the last three days, but weakened against sterling to 17.5790/6200 from 17.5100/5300, tracking a softer U.S. dollar overseas.
It was at 2.2740/2810 against the rand, down from 2.2600/2800 but closed firmer against the mark at 7.0600/0770 compared to 7.0900/1100 the previous day.
